description: Ten global band powers averaged on the nine 10-20 sites George and Gulia 2025 recorded (F3 Fz F4 C3 Cz C4 O1 Oz O2). Same sites for every band: that paper has no per-band electrode list. Derived measures stay on current_v1. Not confirmatory. Cleaning stays full-montage. Hz edges stay Angela/Zheng/Cochran.

provenance.paper: George C, Gulia KK. Ann Neurosci. 2025. doi:10.1177/09727531251341665. Methods: nine unipolar electrodes O1, Oz, O2, C3, Cz, C4, F3, Fz, F4.
provenance.not_used: Table 1 gives region words (frontal, posterior, motor, somatosensory, medial temporal), not electrode names. Wang and Mengoni 2022 likewise give zones, not a fixed per-band list. Do not invent subsets from those words.
provenance.angela_does: Band power on every recorded channel; Zheng and Cochran cited only for Hz edges. Those edges stay: δ 0.5–4, θ 4–8, α 8–13, β 13–30, γ 30–40.

cleaning.note: Do not subset channels before notch, average reference, interpolation, or ICA.
